title: 第29章 有意见床上提第28章 三剑败霍雨
slug: 大罗邪仙苟在剑门当药师
content_zh:
第29章有意见床上提
下一刻，她踏空而起，众目睽睽之下，落在药园之外。
抬步就进……
药园之中，度凌没有坐在往日惯坐的躺椅上。
而是在他的房间。
他这房间窗户，可以看到论剑台。
西门二丝进来，带着一缕香风。
度凌微笑着回头：“我看到了你在台上的表演，真正演绎了‘倾国倾城’。”
“倾国倾城？”西门二丝皱眉。
“是啊，你优雅绝伦的一番展示，霍雨不止是城倾了，天都塌了……”度凌手轻轻一伸，揽住她的细腰，抱了过来：“事实上，我的固有思维也在塌方，这么优雅斯文，这么霸气侧露的二小姐，我真的可以睡得心安理得？”
西门二丝妩媚地白他一眼：“大白天这么煽情，想干嘛？”
“想！”
“不是……我说的是……你想做什么？不是征求你的意见……”西门二丝有点害羞。
不是她不想干，此刻心情激荡，她也想干。
但是，这大白天的，前一刻还在万众瞩目的论剑台上，跟高手对垒，下一刻就到床上去，演绎热血与热汁同时四溢的滋味，是不是有些违和？
“反正我理解的就是这个意思，你有意见到床上提……”度凌手一合，将她抱上了床。
上了床，她的确提了些意见：轻点，温柔点……可以加点速，一点点就好，嗯……
一个时辰之后，西门二丝吐口长气，吹一吹跑偏的秀发，抱住了度凌的脑袋，盯着他的眼睛：“师弟，问个事。”
“说！”
“为什么……为什么我参悟剑意之时，剑碑里会呈现剑道具像？你到底有没有动用阵道什么的，刺激到了先祖剑意？”

“动用阵道，刺激先祖剑意？有这种阵道吗？”
“我不知道有没有这种匪夷所思的阵道，但我死活想不明白，为什么这次参悟会如此反常。”西门二丝道。
“这很难解释吗？太正常了！你跟我睡过！”
西门二丝也是无语了：“跟你睡过就真的气运无边啊？”
“这也不是气运的事，而是你的身体通了，阴阳平衡了，道途也就通达了。”
西门二丝抱着他，深度表扬:“师弟你好神奇，怎么这么神奇啊？不管多么难启齿的事儿，你办得雄纠纠、气昂昂就不提了，论起来竟然也有高度、有境界、充满大道玄机……”
突然一个声音传来……
“度公子，可在？”
这声音苍老舒展。
度凌和西门二丝同时一惊……
“金长老？”度凌的声音压得很低。
他听过金长老的声音，他的声音很有辨识度。
西门二丝就没有他这么敏感了，原本听不出金长老的声音，但听他这么一说，立刻身子一弹，从床上跳起，紧急穿衣。
片刻时间已经恢复成了云淡风轻的仙子形象。
度凌开口了：“在，请进！”
声音一落，他也穿上了衣服，出了房间。
西门二丝对他生出了几许佩服。
自己是修随心道的，大白天干这个，她都觉得随心随性四字有点难以支撑。
他却是大大方方的，丝毫不慌。

Chapter 29 If you have any opinions, bring them up in bed
The next moment, she jumped into the air and landed outside the medicine garden in full view of everyone.
Just take a step forward...
In the medicine garden, Du Ling was not sitting on the recliner he was used to sitting on.
But in his room.
From the window of his room, he could see the sword discussion platform.
Ximen Ersi came in with a wisp of fragrance.
Du Ling looked back with a smile: "I saw your performance on the stage, and you truly performed 'The Country and the City'."
"The whole country and the city?" Ximen Ersi frowned.
"Yes, with your elegant display, Huo Yu not only collapsed the city, but also the sky fell..." Du Ling gently stretched out his hand, wrapped his arms around her waist, and hugged her: "In fact, my inherent thinking is also collapsing. With such an elegant and gentle second lady, such a domineering side, can I really sleep peacefully?"
Ximen Ersi gave him a charming look: "What do you want to do if you are so sensational in broad daylight?"
"Think!"
"No...I'm saying...what do you want to do? I'm not asking for your opinion..." Ximen Ersi was a little shy.
It's not that she doesn't want to do it, but she also wants to do it because her mood is exciting at the moment.
However, in broad daylight, one moment you are on the sword discussion stage where everyone is watching, competing against masters, and the next moment you are on the bed, experiencing the feeling of blood and juice overflowing at the same time. Isn't it a bit inconsistent?
"Anyway, that's what I understand. Do you want to see the bed lifted..." Du Ling clasped his hands and put her on the bed.
After getting into bed, she did make some suggestions: be gentler, be gentler...you can speed up a little bit, just a little bit, um...
An hour later, Ximen Ersi took a long breath, blew her stray hair, hugged Du Ling's head, and stared into his eyes: "Junior brother, I want to ask something."
"Say!"
"Why...why did the sword props appear in the sword monument when I understood the sword intention? Did you use formations or anything to stimulate the ancestor's sword intention?"
"Use the formation to stimulate the ancestors' sword intent? Is there such a formation?"
"I don't know if there is such a weird formation, but I can't figure out why this enlightenment is so abnormal." Ximen Ersi said.
"Is this hard to explain? It's so normal! You slept with me!"
Ximen Ersi was also speechless: "Is it true that I have endless luck after sleeping with you?"
"This is not a matter of luck, but if your body is healthy and your yin and yang are balanced, your path will be clear."
Ximen Ersi hugged him and praised him deeply: "Junior brother, you are so amazing, how come you are so amazing? No matter how hard it is to talk about, you handle it with great courage and high spirits, let alone mention it. When you talk about it, it is actually high-level, state-of-the-art, and full of mysteries..."
Suddenly a voice came...
"Master Du, are you here?"
This voice is old and stretched.
Du Ling and Ximen Ersi were shocked at the same time...
"Elder Jin?" Du Ling's voice was very low.
He had heard Elder Jin's voice, and his voice was very recognizable.
Ximen Ersi was not as sensitive as him. She couldn't hear Elder Jin's voice at first, but when she heard what he said, she immediately jumped up from the bed and dressed urgently.
In a moment, she had returned to the image of a fairy with light clouds and gentle breeze.
Du Ling spoke: "Here, please come in!"
As soon as the voice fell, he also put on his clothes and left the room.
Ximen Ersi had some admiration for him.
She is a practitioner of Sui Xin Dao, and even if she does this in broad daylight, she feels that the four words Sui Xin Sui Sui are a bit difficult to support.
But he was generous and did not panic at all.
